description_en: Performs a paging query on the details of workspace members
description_zh: 分页查询工作空间成员详情
name: ListProjectMembers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace used when you invoke this API operation
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The list of DataWorks account IDs. You can log on to the DataWorks console - Administration (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/product/ms_menu), select the workspace that you want to manage, go to the Administration page, and then go to the Tenant Members and Roles page to view the account IDs
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks账号 ID 列表。您可以登录 DataWorks 控制台——管理中心 (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/product/ms_menu)，选择需要操作的工作空间进入管理中心页面，进入租户成员与角色页面，查看需要操作的账号 ID
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of workspace role codes. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2853930.html operation to obtain the role codes
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间角色 Code 列表。 您可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2853930.html 获取角色的 Code
parameters.name: role_codes

parameters.help_en: The page number of the requested data
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为 10 条，最大 100 条
parameters.name: page_size
